description: Trinkwasserleitung Samtgemeinde Gartow Landkreis Lüchow-Dannenberg is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Drinking water pipe in the Samtgemeinde Gartow of the district Lüchow-Dannenberg. Shown are the drinking water pipe of the Samtgemeinde Gartow as they were mapped in the 80s and 90s. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water pipeline Samtgemeinde Gartow district Lüchow-Dannenberg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasser, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Gartow, Samtgemeinde Gartow, Infrastruktur, Trinkwasserleitung. The listing shows 2024-03-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
